title: Model ingestion license auditflow and restricted-weights triage
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Implement an automated license and restricted-weights auditflow during model onboarding that combines heuristic scanners, provenance checks, and a human triage queue. Goals: prevent models with incompatible licenses or restricted weights from entering hosted, dedicated, or private catalogs; provide transparent decisioning, clear reviewer UX, and telemetry signals that inform routing and enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Automated scanner assigns a license compatibility score and provenance score for >=95% of uploads
Uploads flagged as "restricted" are quarantined and cannot be published to hosted or dedicated catalogs without explicit approval
Reviewer UI surfaces provenance artifacts, license text, weight checksums, and recommended disposition in a single view
Telemetry emitted to Console with per-upload license status, disposition, and reason codes
Publish APIs respect the restriction flag and return clear error codes when publishing is blocked
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Build license parser and matching ruleset (detect common OSI licenses, permutations, and commercial/encumbered flags)
Phase 2: Integrate checksum-based provenance: require model weights checksums and map against known sources and vendor attestations
Phase 3: Human triage queue with templated review decisions and SLA targets for Legal/ModelOps
Phase 4: Enforcement hooks in publishing pipeline and policy layer for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments
risks: False positives creating friction for onboarding legitimate models
Maintaining an accurate ruleset across custom and compound licenses
Ambiguity for derived models trained on mixed-license corpora
Longer onboarding latency for large weight uploads due to provenance verification
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: Run in "informational" mode (no blocks) for internal and beta orgs and collect telemetry
Week 3: Enable quarantine for selected beta orgs (opt-in) and establish reviewer SLAs
Week 6: Expand enforcement to all hosted accounts; Dedicated orgs default to quarantine with admin override
Ongoing: Provide enterprise appeal/override workflow and a regular cadence for ruleset updates with Legal
open_questions: What is our canonical source of license text for variant/compound licenses (OSS license DB vs vendor-supplied) ?
Which team has final disposition authority for flagged uploads (Legal vs ModelOps) ?
How should provenance scoring treat forks and re-trained checkpoints with mixed upstreams ?
Do we allow a limited whitelist of restricted weights for specific enterprise contracts ?

notes: Design: include an "appeal" action that creates an auditable GitHub issue and tracks reviewer history
Policy: use reason codes LICENSE_INCOMPATIBLE, RESTRICTED_WEIGHTS, PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN for telemetry and API errors
Private/On-prem: enforcement should be configurable per tenant policy; default to strict mode for enterprise accounts
